mentions.name: Rotadeck
mentions.description: An EU-based incident management platform built as a PagerDuty replacement, focusing on the absolute basics: SSO is included even on the free tier, with no AI-driven workflows or overviews, though ML/AI-driven insights may be added in the future.
mentions.problem: Existing incident management tooling lacks an EU-based PagerDuty alternative, and SSO is typically gated behind paid plans rather than available on free tiers.
mentions.source_excerpt: An EU replacement for PagerDuty, focusing on the absolute basics - SSO as the minimum even on free, no AI driven workflows, overviews etc. but may include ML/AI driven insights in future since that's the way the world seems to be going.

evidence.value: An EU replacement for PagerDuty, focusing on the absolute basics - SSO as the minimum even on free, no AI driven workflows, overviews etc. but may include ML/AI driven insights in future since that's the way the world seems to be going.
